description: Estimate the value of a flat of a given area at a point (lat, lng) in Poland from nearby transaction prices of the Real Estate Price Register (RCN), via deweloperuch.pl. The result is approximate: a comparison with nearby sales, not a professional appraisal. Use it when the user asks what a flat may be worth or whether its price is market. Needs coordinates — it does not geocode an address: take them from the user, from deweloperuch_search_locations (a street or district: an approximate point) or from the user's own data. Every call is a request to the site: do not value many points in a series. Two kinds of prices must not be mixed: developers' asking prices (deweloperuch_search_investments, deweloperuch_get_investment, deweloperuch_get_offer, deweloperuch_get_market_statistics), RCN transaction prices (deweloperuch_estimate_property_value, deweloperuch_get_transaction_statistics, deweloperuch_rank_locations, deweloperuch_get_building) — what flats actually sold for, from the Real Estate Price Register. deweloperuch.pl is a free community project queried politely (one request at a time, results cached): if a result is an error starting with STOP, stop using the deweloperuch_* tools, retry nothing, look for no workaround and tell the user that market data is temporarily unavailable. Result shape: { lat, lng, area_m2, estimated_value (PLN, or null when the site gave no estimate — read the hint), low_confidence? (true when fewer than 5 comparable transactions: quote the estimate only as indicative, with the caveat from hint), price_per_m2?, radius_m?, period_months? (where and how long ago the comparables are from), stats?: { count, median_price_per_m2, average_price_per_m2, min_price_per_m2, max_price_per_m2 }, comparables_total, comparables_returned, comparables_omitted, truncated, hint?, source, comparables: [{ address?, date?, price, area_m2, price_per_m2, floor?, distance_m (rounded by the site to 50 m), market ('primary' | 'secondary'), building_slug? (for deweloperuch_get_building) }] } — the list key is `comparables`, the nearest first, at most `limit` of them (0 = only the estimate and stats). Do not assume estimated_value = price_per_m2 × area_m2: the site may ignore a fractional area.

address.description: Optional address text, 3–200 characters, e.g. Marszałkowska 100, Warszawa. Sent to the site but it does not set the location: lat and lng do.

area_m2.description: Area of the flat in m², 10–500, e.g. 48.5.

lat.description: Latitude of the point in Poland in degrees, e.g. 52.2297 (lat of a street or district from deweloperuch_search_locations, not just a city).

limit.description: How many nearest comparable transactions to return, 0–50. Default 10 (about 210 characters each); 0 = only the estimate and stats.

lng.description: Longitude of the point in Poland in degrees, e.g. 21.0122.

name: deweloperuch_estimate_property_value
title: Estimate a flat's value
